labels.CENTER: Defects concentrated in a compact central region.
labels.RING: Defects form a circumferential annulus with a relatively sparse center.
labels.SCRATCH: Defects aligned in a narrow, approximately straight track.
labels.RANDOM: Defects dispersed throughout the wafer without a dominant cluster, annulus or line.
labels.EMPTY: No inspection defect points are visible; the gray wafer boundary is not a defect.
